تفتحلين (form VIII)
# تَفْتَحِلِينَ (taftaḥilīna) /taf.ta.ħi.liː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِفْتَحَلَ (iftaḥala)
# تُفْتَحَلِينَ (tuftaḥalīna) /tuf.ta.ħa.liː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِفْتَحَلَ (iftaḥala)
